mismatchTracker.title: Mismatch Tracker
mismatchTracker.subtitle: Track, dispute, and resolve payment discrepancies with your providers
mismatchTracker.howItWorks1: Weekly Batch — One consolidated report per provider with all discrepancies (new + carried-forward)
mismatchTracker.howItWorks2: Three Sections — New discrepancies, still-unresolved from previous reports, and recently resolved
mismatchTracker.howItWorks3: Urgent Override — For large amounts or missing payouts, switch to "⚡ Urgent" and send immediately
mismatchTracker.howItWorks4: Auto-Check — After each bank upload, the system scans for automatic resolutions
mismatchTracker.howItWorks5: Track Times Reported — The provider can't claim they never received it

communications.title: Dispute Communications
communications.subtitle: Track every email sent to your payment providers. See what was disputed, when it was sent, and whether it was delivered
communications.noCommunicationsDesc: Emails sent from Mismatch Tracker will appear here automatically

setup.title: Setup
setup.subtitle: Manage your client portfolio, stores, providers, bank accounts, and data privacy
setup.addFirstClient: Add your first client to build your portfolio
setup.disputeEmailDesc: Set the dispute contact email for each provider. These emails are used when you click "Send Email" from Mismatch Tracker
setup.dataResidencyDesc: All data stored exclusively in European data centers (Frankfurt / Paris)
setup.encryptionDesc: Encrypted at rest. TLS 1.3 in transit. Your bank statements are unreadable to us without your session
setup.zeroSharingDesc: We do not share your data with tax authorities, advertisers, AI trainers, or third parties. Ever
setup.gdprDesc: Right to access, right to erasure, right to portability. Request your data anytime
setup.autoPurgeDesc: Automatically delete transaction data older than the selected period
setup.dangerZoneDesc: Deleting your data is irreversible. Your bank statements, provider transactions, and store configuration will be permanently removed

upload.title: Upload Center
upload.subtitle: Upload bank statements, TPV reports, and provider transactions
